name: flowtrace
description: Plan a change before any code, and explain one to someone who has never seen it. plan-flows reads the code the change touches, researches how it is best done, writes the plan and draws its page for you to read, answer and approve; plan-check then questions the approved plan; explain teaches how something works or asks you to choose, with one worked example traced through today and after. In the Claude app, a hook holds a choice in the next-step box until its page is out.
